title: Sea otters keep a favorite rock
topic: Sea otters store a preferred anvil stone in a loose skin pouch under the foreleg and reuse it for years
voice_script: A sea otter keeps a favorite rock. Under each front leg there is a loose pouch of skin, and that is where the rock lives. It comes out when the otter finds something it cannot open. The otter floats on its back, balances the rock on its chest, and hammers the shell against it. Then the rock goes back in the pouch. Otters keep the same one for years. It is the only tool most of them will ever own.
